$comment: Third-party license policy read by scripts/check-licenses.mjs. Verdicts: allow passes; review FAILS unless the exact package@version is listed in the reviewed array with a reason (after reading its license text); deny and unknown fail. packageOverrides entries require an exact version. The license of every vendored entry is classified too. Entries are SPDX ids (case-insensitive) or PREFIX* patterns. Deny wins over allow, allow over review. A compound expression is judged per SPDX semantics (OR: best branch, AND: worst branch). Each vendored entry also states its copyright lines, a committed copy of the upstream license text (licenseFile), the verbatim upstream NOTICE text when there is one (notice), and the third-party code it embeds (includes: [{ name, license, copyright }]); THIRD_PARTY.md reproduces all of them, note stays internal.

packageOverrides.reason: package.json declares the ambiguous id "BSD"; the shipped LICENSE file is the two-clause BSD text.
